Full summary: Task 11 (inline): canvas density timeline shipped, vis-timeline deleted (2 vendor files, ~250 lines of glue). Browser-verified at 5k: stacked weekly bars with burst pattern, semantic zoom flips to lozenge lanes under 150 visible (superseded struck through), click-to-detail, synced list, domain chips, color-by toggle, now-marker. Suite 1173 green, build copies js/ into dist. PHASE 3 COMPLETE.
Decisions: Kept the existing toolbar/legend/chips DOM ids (timeline-zoom-in/out/fit/today, timeline-legend, timeline-domain-filters) so the HTML shell and its styling carried over unchanged — only the rendering engine swapped.; Lozenge lane layout uses first-fit lane assignment with label-width-aware collision (measureText) rather than vis-timeline-style stacking — O(n·lanes), no DOM, and lanes below the fold are simply not drawn at extreme densities (mode note tells the user to zoom).; Removed the fetchDecisions→timeline sync side effect entirely — the new timeline subscribes to the shared index store, so legacy state.decisions.data no longer feeds any visualization.
Findings: Old #timeline-container CSS (fixed 600px height for vis-timeline) left a large empty box under the new 340px canvas — trimmed to position:relative only. Watch for similar stale sizing rules when the graph view is replaced in Phase 4.
